hooks.command: $port = 3000; $inUse = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($inUse) { Write-Output '{"systemMessage": "Justice Den server already running on :3000"}' } else { Start-Process -FilePath 'node' -ArgumentList 'server.js' -WorkingDirectory 'C:\Users\scoot\JusticeDenLister' -WindowStyle Hidden; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $check = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($check) { Write-Output '{"systemMessage": "Justice Den server started on http://localhost:3000"}' } else { Write-Output '{"systemMessage": "Warning: server may not have started — check manually"}' } }
